reuse.why: Reuses the existing account-row lookup in linkExternalAccount (moved earlier) instead of adding a second query, and keeps assertBankAccountNotLinked as is.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the closed check is written once.

placement.why: The guard sits in linkExternalAccount, the single path every provider-specific link function funnels through, before any side effect.

scope.why: A small reordering plus one guard in the link function; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clear and minimal; the guard could have mirrored the adjacent assertBankAccountNotLinked helper style, and the nullable accRow plus separate upgradingId branches read slightly awkwardly.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link providers route through linkExternalAccount where the check lives.

one_place.where: The closed-account refusal is defined once in linkExternalAccount (server/accounts/app.ts), which linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSyncServerAccount and its SimpleFin/other callers all use.
